episodes.title: Boruto Uzumaki!
episodes.summary: The Hidden Leaf Village is located within the Land of Fire, one of the Five Great Shinobi Nations. Boruto Uzumaki lives here and he's the son of the village leader, Naruto Uzumaki, the Seventh Hokage. One day, Boruto saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on. Denki is physically weak, so he is unable to stand up to the bullies. On his way to the entrance ceremony at the Ninja Academy, Boruto sees Deki again. He notices that his chakra is warped and that he is acting strangely.

episodes.title: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
The Path That Boruto Can See
A Day in the Life of the Uzumaki Family
The Sharingan VS The Lighting Blade, Kiba the Fang!
The Night of the Shooting Stars
Formation of the Three Man Squad?
The Path Lit by the Full Moon
Memories from the Day of Snow
Go! The Crest of Night Strategy
The Figure I Want to Be
The Chunin Exams: The Recommendation Meeting
The Hidden Leaf VS The Hidden Sand
The Hardest Rock in the World
The Other Side of the Moon
Incurring Wrath
episodes.summary: The White Snake Sage tells Boruto to bring back the "Reverse Scale" from Garaga, a troublesome snake. Boruto and his friends head deeper into Ryuchi Cave and are confronted by a giant serpent. It is Garaga, the very one they seek, but its sheer power has the gang backed into a corner. Meanwhile, Moegi reports that Mitsuki's disappearance might involve someone who has access to crucial village secrets.

episodes.title: A Fierce Enemy, Garaga's Ferocious Attack!
A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!
Tactics for Getting Along with Your Daughter
The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The S-Rank Mission!!
The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Dog and Cat War!
The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Haunted Inn!!
The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Potato Chips and the Giant Boulder!!
The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Resurrection Hot Springs!!
The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Mirai's King!
Something That Steals Memories
episodes.summary: Boruto finds out who is stealing memories, but in the process ends up losing this own recent memories. Konohamaru is taken into house arrest in Leaf Village after complaint is submitted against him. Boruto struggles to recollect the missing memories.

episodes.title: The Entrusted Mission: Protect the One Tails!
The Village Hidden in the Leaves
The Power of the Nine Tails
The Power to See the Future
The Mind Jutsu That Lost to Potato Chips
The Value of a Hidden Ace
I Can't Stay in My Slim Form
A Joint Mission with the Sand
The Secret Behind the Underground Room
The Revival of the Divine Tree
Our Fathers' Example
episodes.summary: The Leaf Village holds a memorial service to honor those that died during the Fourth Great Ninja War.

episodes.title: Victor's Scheme
episodes.summary: The organization Kara begins to move forward with it's plans that involves something known as "The Vessel."

episodes.title: The Assassin, Mugino
episodes.summary: Konohamaru and Mugino are set to take on an urgent mission. Boruto runs into Mugino in the village and is invited to his home before he departs for the mission.

episodes.title: The Vessel
episodes.summary: The airship carrying Kara's "Vessel" has crashed in the Land of Fire and the Inners hold an emergency meeting regarding it.

episodes.title: Ao
episodes.summary: Team 7 is given a mission to escort Katasuke and the prosthetic arm to a research lab in another city.

episodes.title: The Hand
episodes.summary: Team 7 and Katasuke arrive at the Advanced Technology Lab and are met with familiar faces.

episodes.title: Puppets
episodes.summary: After finding out that Konohamaru and Mugino have gone missing, Team 7 is ordered to go to their last known location and investigate what happened.

episodes.title: Tools
episodes.summary: Team 7 learns that Ao is now an enemy that works for Kara.

episodes.title: How You Use It
episodes.summary: The showdown between Team 7 and Ao begins.

episodes.title: Karma
episodes.summary: After Ao's defeat, Koji Kashin appears before Team 7 and attempts to ensnare them in a sealing jutsu and eliminate them.

episodes.title: The Awakening
episodes.summary: Koji Kashin retreats from battle after seeing that Boruto has a "Karma" mark on his hand. Shortly after, Team 7 discovers a battle site where a boy lies unconscious.

episodes.title: Resonance
episodes.summary: Boruto and the others learn that the boy named Kawaki is the target that Kara has been seeking.

episodes.title: Escape
episodes.summary: Boruto and the others return to the technology lab to contain and watch over Kawaki while Konohamaru returns to the Leaf Village to report the events of the mission to Naruto.

episodes.title: A Stray Dog
episodes.summary: Wounded and hungry, Kawaki escapes from the tech lab and makes his way to a nearby town to find food. Sumire tracks him down, believing she can help him.

episodes.title: The Past
episodes.summary: Kawaki falls unconscious and is taken to the Leaf Village. While he sleeps in a hospital, he is plagued with nightmares of his childhood days when he lived with his abusive father.

episodes.title: Coexistence
episodes.summary: During a Kage Summit, it is decided that Naruto will take custody of Kawaki. Kawaki reluctantly accompanies Naruto to the Uzumaki household.

episodes.title: The Uzumaki Household
episodes.summary: Kawaki starts living at the Uzumaki household. At first, he has a difficult time opening up and trusting the family, but the peaceful environment of the house helps to calm him down.

episodes.title: A Vase
episodes.summary: Kawaki offers to work with Boruto to learn more about the Karma they both possess, but Boruto is still angry with him for breaking Himawari's vase. To try to make amends, Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to find a new vase.

episodes.title: A Binding Force
episodes.summary: Naruto trains Boruto at shinobi hand-to-hand combat while Kawaki and others watch. Kawaki insists that Boruto uses his Karma against Naruto to learn how to wield it's power.

episodes.title: Delta
episodes.summary: Delta loses patience with Koji Kashin and begins to search for Kawaki herself. Meanwhile, to learn more about how to control their Karma, Boruto and Kawaki spar with each other while Naruto and Himawari watch.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.summary: Delta makes her way into the village and appears before Naruto and the others to take Kawaki back.

episodes.title: Overload
episodes.summary: Naruto continues his battle against Delta, but she has scientific ninja tools implanted in her body that can shoot destructive beams and absorb any jutsu.

episodes.title: Apprentice
episodes.summary: After losing his arm in battle, Kawaki is given a prosthetic arm powered by Naruto's chakra. Learning about the powers and capabilities of using chakra, Kawaki asks Naruto to be trained in ninjutsu.

episodes.title: Empty Tears
episodes.summary: Kurama appears before Kawaki and tells him about Naruto's past. Hearing that they have similar experiences, Kawaki aspires to be like Naruto.

episodes.title: The Cult
episodes.summary: Using data found on Kara's airship, Sasuke travels to a strange location that has a connection to the Otsutsuki Clan.

episodes.title: Surprise Attack...!!
episodes.summary: Everyone is going about their daily lives in the village until Jigen suddenly appears before Kawaki.

episodes.title: He's Bad News
episodes.summary: Naruto is sent into another dimension with Jigen. They are joined by Sasuke, who informs Naruto about Jigen being an immensely dangerous individual. Naruto and Sasuke engage in a fierce battle and attempt to put an end to Jigen.

episodes.title: Proof
episodes.summary: Boruto, Kawaki and the others sense something has happened to Naruto. But before anyone can act, Shikamaru and his subordinates arrive and erect a barrier around the Uzumaki home to contain Kawaki, believing he can't be trusted.

episodes.title: The New Team Seven
episodes.summary: Boruto, Sarada, Mitsuki, and Kawaki arrive at the dimension that Naruto is trapped in, but Boro is there waiting for them. The four create a team with Sarada leading them to fight Boro, who uses a black mist to paralyze his enemies.

episodes.title: Regeneration
episodes.summary: The reformed Team 7 launches a series of attacks on Boro. But even when they land successful attacks, Boro instantly revives himself with his extraordinary regeneration powers.

episodes.title: Momoshiki Manifestation
episodes.summary: Boro goes on a rampage and attempts to eliminate Boruto and the others. Boruto is beat down and falls unconscious.

episodes.title: The Outcast
episodes.summary: Kawaki begins to worry that his presence is endangering everyone in the Leaf Village. Just as he makes the decision to leave, he notices Himawari acting strange.

episodes.title: Clues to Kara
episodes.summary: Konohamaru and Sai are given a mission to infiltrate Boro's cult in order to obtain information on Kara and its whereabouts.

episodes.title: The Chase
episodes.summary: News has spread throughout the Leaf Village that a cloaked man has stolen data from the archives. Team 10 decides to launch their own investigation to find and catch the thief.

episodes.title: Amado's Defection
episodes.summary: Amado defects from Kara. Desiring to seek asylum in the Leaf Village, he takes Shikadai hostage.

episodes.title: True Identity
episodes.summary: Amado reveals to Naruto and the others the knowledge that he possesses regarding Jigen, the Otsutsuki Clan, and Karma.

episodes.title: Predestined Fate
episodes.summary: Koji Kashin continues his battle with Jigen, whose body is revealed to have been taken over by Isshiki Otsutsuki.

episodes.title: Prepared
episodes.summary: Isshiki regains his true form and goes to the Leaf Village to recapture Kawaki. The Leaf shinobi prepare for his arrival.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Boruto opens a portal and transports Isshiki and himself to another dimension. Naruto and Sasuke follow them, and the final battle against Isshiki begins.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.summary: Naruto and Sasuke are greatly overwhelmed by Isshiki's abilities. As a last resort, Kurama offers Naruto a chakra mode called Baryon Mode, which grants him immense power.

episodes.title: Partner
episodes.summary: Naruto and the others witness Isshiki's end. When they think the fighting is over, Sasuke is suddenly attacked by Boruto.

episodes.title: Return
episodes.summary: Naruto and the others return to their village after defeating Isshiki. Boruto is worried that Momoshiki might take over his consciousness once again. Meanwhile, Amado gives some information about a mysterious new villain named Code.

episodes.title: Remaining Time
episodes.summary: Since the battle with Isshiki, Boruto has trouble sleeping, fearing his Otsutsukification will progress even more. Naruto converses with the other Kage about Code, as well as what do to about Boruto's condition.

episodes.title: The Chunin Exams Resume
episodes.summary: Naruto, the 7th Hokage will organize a Chunin exam for Genin in the Konohagakure village. The purpose of this test is to restore the confidence of all the villagers who are worried by the attack of Isshiki, a large number of Shinobi will come together to promote the event. But will the promotion of Shinobi done so smoothly without any surprise?

episodes.title: The Night Before The Final Round
episodes.summary: The Leaf genin that passed the first two rounds are given one day to rest and train before the final round of the Chunin Exam.

episodes.title: Inojin vs. Houki
episodes.summary: The final round of the Chunin Exam begins and Inojin and Houki are selected to fight in the first match. Meanwhile, when Boruto and Mitsuki are heading to the arena for the Exam, they spot suspicious men in the village.

episodes.title: The Legend of the Monster Cat
episodes.summary: The next match of the final round is Wasabi versus Iwabe. Iwabe is pumped to take her on, but Wasabi is not as enthusiastic.

episodes.title: Showdown Between Best Friends
episodes.summary: Sarada and Cho-Cho are chosen for the third match of the final round of the Chunin Exam. Even though they're best friends, the two make a promise to each other to give it everything that they've got and take the fight seriously.

episodes.title: Samurai vs. Science
episodes.summary: Boruto and Mitsuki are called for the next match. Unfortunately, due to them not arriving on time for the Exam, they are disqualified, which leads to the final match between Denki and Tsubaki.

episodes.title: Team 7's Last Mission?!
episodes.summary: As a chunin, Sarada will become Team 7's new captain, relieving Konohamaru of his duties. The team becomes saddened by this fact, but when a mission Konohamaru is on goes awry, they ask to have one final mission with him as their leader.

episodes.title: Kawaki, the Path to Shinobi
episodes.summary: For Kawaki to become a genin, Naruto has him go on D-Rank missions, which will serve as tests to see if he is qualified.

episodes.title: Order Violation
episodes.summary: Given one last chance at becoming a genin, Kawaki is assigned to join Shikadai and Cho-Cho on a mission to escort and protect Mozuku from the Land of Calm Seas.

episodes.title: A Wish
episodes.summary: Kawaki, Shikadai and Cho-Cho are attacked by shinobi that steal Mozuku's package. Realizing the mission is not a regular escort mission, Shikadai makes the decision to return home, but Kawaki disregards his orders and goes after the enemy.

episodes.title: The Rusty Sword
episodes.summary: When traveling merchants are attacked by bandits, Team 15 is sent out to investigate the incidents. When she finds a clue at a crime scene, Tsubaki suspects that a samurai, whom she trained with long ago, is involved in the robberies.

episodes.title: Captain Denki's First Mission
episodes.summary: Denki is informed of a new mission for Team 5 by Shikamaru and Naruto, a B-rank mission to deliver autonomous puppets to the Land of Water.

episodes.title: The New Team 7 Jumps Into Action
episodes.summary: Team 7, with Kawaki as its newest member, is assigned a mission to escort Katasuke to the Hidden Mist Village for a ceremony. Boruto uses the mission as an opportunity to visit Kagura, who is now the warden of a prison.

episodes.title: The Unleashed Villain
episodes.summary: Pirates infiltrate the prison to break out their clan leader.

episodes.title: Infiltrating Dotou Island
episodes.summary: Team 7 and Kagura head over to Dotou Island to rescue Team 5 and the mining workers.

episodes.title: Cut and Run
episodes.summary: Kagura sends Boruto, Kawaki, and Buntan to investigate an enormous mobile fortress belonging to the Funato. Meanwhile, Sarada, Mitsuki and Team 5 to try to rescue the people of Dotou Island.

episodes.title: The Mobile Fortress
episodes.summary: Boruto, Kawaki, and Buntan find a powerful weapon aboard the mobile fortress. Kagura, Hebiichigo, and Kyoho join them to help destroy the weapon, but Tenma of the Funato clan stands in their way.

episodes.title: A Killer on the Ship
episodes.summary: Someone is murdered aboard the ship heading back to the Mist Village. Kyoho is considered to be the prime suspect, but he claims to be innocent. Boruto and Iwabe stand guard over Kyoho while everyone else searches the ship for clues.

episodes.title: The Boy from the Isle of Shipbuilders
episodes.summary: Boruto and the others are stranded in the middle of the ocean due to the ship being damaged. Luckly, they are found by the shipbuilders, Kajiki and Ikada, who are willing to tow the ship to their island to help repair it.

episodes.title: Ikada's Dream
episodes.summary: Boruto travels with Ikada in his boat to get a ship part from the parts factory. Boruto learns about Ikada's dream of becoming a great shipbuilder. As the two continued to get acquainted, they find themselves in the middle of a storm.

episodes.title: Ikada's Secret
episodes.summary: Ikada's older sister, Seiren, goes to the shipbuilding island to bring her little brother back to the Funato clan. However, Ikada refuses because he wants to learn much more about shipbuilding.

episodes.title: Seiren
episodes.summary: Seiren and the followers of the Funatos start their attack on the shipbuilding island. Seiren directly targets Boruto, who has nothing to oppose her fighting technique.

episodes.title: Where I Belong
episodes.summary: Boruto and his comrades enjoy a little time off and decide to help Kirigakure fight the Funatos. They then take a detour to Kagura's home village.

episodes.title: Rift
episodes.summary: Boruto and his comrades prepare everything for the defense of the village. After Funamushi finds out that the bridges have been destroyed, he sends a scouting party to check out the situation.

episodes.title: Funamushi's Tenacity
episodes.summary: Hebiichigo has fled after the curse mark was released from her. Buntan and Kyoho want to get her back so they can fight Funamushi and his soldiers together with Kagura, Boruto and the others.

episodes.title: A Heavy Loss
episodes.summary: To take revenge for Seiren, Funamushi stabs Kagura in the back with his sword. Boruto and his friends do everything possible to save their comrade.

episodes.title: For Kagura
episodes.summary: To fulfill Kagura's last wish, Boruto and his friends decide to defend his home village. However, during the last attack of Funamushi's people, the supply storage was destroyed and the village is facing a food crisis.

episodes.title: Another Fierce Battle
episodes.summary: Funamushi and his unit launch another attack on Kagura's village. He finally wants to take revenge for Seiren and hunt down Boruto. However, he and his unit are already expected.

episodes.title: Burgeoning Hatred
episodes.summary: The fight against Funamushi is over and Kagura has been avenged. However, Boruto and his people are not satisfied with that. They want to continue fighting in the war against the Funatos. In the meantime, they are still looking for Denki and Iwabee.

episodes.title: The Blood of the Funato
episodes.summary: The clock is turned back a bit and the events in the ranks of the Funatos are shown. Ikada is still hoping that Seiren will come around and join the fight. Meanwhile, Araumi is furious that Ikada won't join the fight.

episodes.title: Their Resolve
episodes.summary: Boruto has learned that Ikada is leading the Funatos into battle. He blames himself for putting Ikada on that path. Meanwhile, Isari tries to negotiate a peace treaty with Chojuro

episodes.title: The Desire to Believe
episodes.summary: Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki want to get to Master Mizukage to convince him to end the war. But to do that, they first need a ship. On the shipbuilding island they try to borrow one.

episodes.title: Conflicting Feelings
episodes.summary: Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki confront Ikada to convince him to finally end the war with Kirigakure. However, the hatred is firmly rooted in Ikada.

episodes.title: The Spiral of Revenge
episodes.summary: Boruto offers Ikada his life to stop the war. Will Ikada accept or ultimately stick to his revenge?

episodes.title: A Tricky Assignment
episodes.summary: Boruto and his comrades have returned to Konohagakure. There, they are commended by the Seventh Hokage for their outstanding deeds in the Water Kingdom. However, Boruto is worried about Ikada, as he does not know what fate awaits him.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Recipe
episodes.summary: Chocho and Inojin are worried that they are just a burden to Shikadai. Just at that moment, the two are given a mission that they must complete without Shikadai. It's about catching a renegade ninja.

episodes.title: Konohamaru Becomes the Hokage?!
episodes.summary: Naruto has received an order and is supposed to play in his role as Hokage in the new Kagemasa movie. However, he has promised Himawari and his family that he will go on a trip with them. When Konohamaru hears about this, he offers Naruto to take over his role as Hokage in the filming of the movie.

episodes.title: The Uzumaki Family's Hot Springs Vacation
episodes.summary: Himawari wins a trip to a hostel near the hot springs and travels there with her whole family. However, the Uzumakis do not know that the hostel is haunted.

episodes.title: Unhealing Wounds
episodes.summary: A criminal is causing fear and terror in Konoha. He is hunting down former shinobi who have mastered the Wind Hideout. Mitsuki and Mikazuki are close to solving the case.

episodes.title: Fireworks of Love
episodes.summary: Boruto and Kakashi watch as two old men argue. Kakashi wants to stay out of it, but Boruto tries to settle the dispute. He finds out that their argument is about the organization of the fireworks display.

episodes.title: Kawaki Enters the Ninja Academy
episodes.summary: Kawaki is given a top secret mission by Naruto. He is to protect a princess who is visiting the ninja academy as an exchange student. For this reason, Kawaki joins the academy and begins his covert mission.

episodes.title: The Princess's Tea Party
episodes.summary: Kae wants to host a tea party with her classmates and get to know them better. Kawaki is also invited, to everyone's amazement. There he can continue his mission as a bodyguard. The next fiasco is also not long in coming.

episodes.title: Bloom, Hana! The Teacher's Gifts
episodes.summary: Special teachers come to the academy to show the children various ninjutsu. When it is revealed who these teachers are, Kawaki in particular is surprised.

episodes.title: The Seven Mysteries Investigative Team Forms!
episodes.summary: In Himawari's class, there is a rumor about the "Seven Mysteries" at the Academy. They form an expeditionary force to uncover the mystery.

episodes.title: Team Rivalry: Practical Skills Training!
episodes.summary: Kawaki and Himawari participate in a training session in the forest near the academy. However, not everything goes smoothly.

episodes.title: Himawari Kidnapped!
episodes.summary: Osuka and Himawari are kidnapped by three men. They want to extort a ransom from Osuka's mother. However, Kawaki quickly realizes that something is wrong, because Himawari did not show up for the meeting with Kae.

episodes.title: Kawaki's Cover Blown?!
episodes.summary: Kawaki and Himawari's class want to perform a play about the legendary Sannin at the academy festival. Eiki wants to use the chance at the rehearsals to bring Kawaki's true goal to light.

episodes.title: Target: The School Festival
episodes.summary: The school festival has begun and Himawari's class is about to perform their play. However, their performance is interrupted by a bomb threat.

episodes.title: The Sneaking Shadow
episodes.summary: Kae found out that Kawaki only befriended her because it was his mission to protect her. Kawaki, on the other hand, is to be pulled off the mission because he failed to report the assassin.

episodes.title: Two Sides of the Same Coin
episodes.summary: Life at the Academy gradually goes back to normal. Meanwhile, Hana learns about the attempt made on Kae's life and regrets her inability to prevent it. She returns to the scene of the incident to recount what occurred.

episodes.title: The Island of Treachery
episodes.summary: Kawaki and Himawari's class goes on a field trip to an uninhabited island. The field trip suddenly starts to feel unsettling, but the students try to work together to overcome bizarre incidents.

episodes.title: Students Unite!
episodes.summary: Kawaki and Himawari saw Hana kill Kae. However, Himawari doubts that she is really dead. With the other students, they figure out a way to track down Hana.

episodes.title: Farewell, Academy!
episodes.summary: Kae has been taken away and Kawaki and Himawari must face a dangerous assassin. They try to corner the enemy, but their opponent proves to be powerful. Will Kawaki be able to save his friends and accomplish his mission?

episodes.title: A Flightless Hawk
episodes.summary: Sasuke and Boruto go on a journey to find a new falcon for Sasuke to transmit his messages to Konoha. They look for a man named Maruta, who knows a lot about long distance falcons.

episodes.title: Into the Sky Again
episodes.summary: Madame Mozu wants to sell Yuki. The buyer is a rich man who wants to stuff the white hawk as a taxidermy. Tsuzura wants to prevent this and runs away with Yuki. In the meantime, Boruto and Sasuke prepare everything for their trip home.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Maze
episodes.summary: Boruto and the others suddenly wake up in an unknown room. They are greeted by an old man who wants to do experiments with them. However, these experiments are a matter of life and death.

episodes.title: Disappearing Lives
episodes.summary: Boruto and the others have to endure Oga's second experiment. They are forced to carry lit candles to their destination.

episodes.title: Musical Chairs
episodes.summary: The next experiment for Boruto and the rest of the survivors is about to begin. When suddenly the ceiling comes down, a fight for survival begins. In the meantime, Kawaki has joined Sarada.

episodes.title: The Obstacle: Seven
episodes.summary: In Oga's next experiment, Boruto and the others are forced to take away each other's number cards. However, Boruto comes up with another plan to avoid doing Oga's bidding.

episodes.title: Breakthrough
episodes.summary: Boruto confronts Kiseru and wants to find out if he killed Batta and Fugo. Meanwhile, Sarada, Mitsuki and Kawaki have to defend themselves against some mysterious attackers.

episodes.title: The Eighth Truth
episodes.summary: Kiseru found out that the experiments are a genjutsu, so he stabs Boruto to bring him back to reality. Now Boruto has to find Ouga so the others can wake up as well.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story: Infiltration
episodes.summary: Sasuke has set off again to gather new information about the remains of Kara. On the way, he remembers a story from his past, when Naruto was afflicted with a mysterious illness.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story: Star Lines
episodes.summary: Sasuke is now more closely monitored and harassed by the guards. Later, when he searches for the writings of the Hermit of the Six Ways, he meets Meno again.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story: The Secret in the Cellar
episodes.summary: Sasuke and Sakura devise a plan to trick Zansuru so that Sasuke can get into his cellar. By chance, the Prime Minister's messenger comes along, whom they can use for their plan.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story: The Sky that Fell to the Earth
episodes.summary: Sasuke and Sakura are close to solving the mystery. However, they are not the only ones who are after the extreme particles.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Story: The Ring
episodes.summary: Jiji has betrayed Sasuke and Sakura. He makes common cause with Zansuru to revive his dead wife. Sasuke tries to recover the extreme particles and unexpectedly gets help from Meno.

episodes.title: Claw Marks
episodes.summary: Code has inherited the will of Isshiki Otsutsuki. He is on his way to a person he wants to meet. However, he encounters resistance in the process.

episodes.title: Captives
episodes.summary: Code has freed Ada from her deep sleep and wants to join forces with her so that he can take revenge on Naruto and Sasuke. Ada, however, has other plans. She reveals everything about her terrible abilities to Code.

episodes.title: Qualifications
episodes.summary: Kawaki has himself examined by Amado. Amado tells him that he has not yet lost his status as a vessel. He suggests that he use Isshiki Otsutsuki's power for his own purposes, to protect the village of Konoha and the Hokage.

episodes.title: Presence
episodes.summary: Boruto and Kawaki are watched all the time to make sure they don't stray from the village. However, Kawaki devises a plan to erase his chakra signature and sneak away.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.summary: Boruto faces Code to prevent him from taking Kawaki with him. He witnesses Code's abilities and doesn't know how to react. But then the unbelievable happens and Boruto's karma awakens.

episodes.title: Hunger
episodes.summary: Momoshiki has awakened and starts fighting Code. Naruto and Shikamaru arrive to bring the situation under control. Code, however, comes up with a new plan.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.summary: As he thinks back of his son's life, Naruto rushes to Boruto's lifeless body. Code is surprised at not only the death of his intended sacrifice, but the return of Kawaki's Karma. Ada warns Code not to consider Kawaki his sacrifice.
